About Vynix Projects

Vynix Projects is my brand for publishing Minecraft creations. I'm Axolium (aka OpRGamerz15), based in Dhaka, Bangladesh. I focus on building modpacks and shaders — projects that enhance gameplay while keeping performance smooth.

All my projects are open source and available on GitHub. Join my Discord server for support, suggestions, and community.
